_comments: Template for ~/.claude/settings.json. The installer substitutes ${HOME} with
$env:USERPROFILE on Windows or $HOME on macOS/Linux before writing the file.
Hook paths use forward slashes; both Windows and POSIX Python accept them.
Strip the _comments key before installing (the installer does this).
Hook scripts must already exist at ${HOME}/.claude/hooks/ -- see hooks/ in the
repo root and the install script. PreCompact and SessionStart preserve context
across /compact; PostToolUse runs format-on-edit after Edit/Write/MultiEdit.
skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt defaults to false in this template. Lan runs
it true locally, but for a public default we keep the prompt on -- flip to true
after you've vetted your own allowlist.
voiceEnabled is off by default; turn on if you have the voice integration set up.
permissions.defaultMode: 'auto' lets allowlisted commands run without prompting;
everything else still prompts. Use 'ask' to prompt on every tool call.
